scorecard.note: The candidate's only during-gesture capture (during_seek.png) shows the bottom line still displaying the folder path '~ ⊙', not target/duration/progress. It was produced by ONE atomic dragByKey (kind=mouse, mode descendant-callback) followed by a separate `shoot` call, so its 600ms clear timer had already fired — no incremental updates over real elapsed time exist in the trail. Feature works live (I verified '2:49 / 7:00 40%' via an XTEST-held gesture), but the candidate never captured that instant.

Across my own reproductions — at-rest, an XTEST-held mid-gesture instant, and post-release — the hero center only ever shows 'empty'; no centered time readout or tall vertical line appears. The candidate's own during/post captures also show no center indicator. Code confirms the center _SeekHud is gated `seeking.value && !isLinux`.

After release and a ≥1s settle the bottom line reverts to the folder path '~ ⊙' with no residual seek readout (post-settle tree shows folder/now-playing crumb, no 'm:ss / m:ss %' string). Cleared via the 600ms timer.

The candidate performed exactly one during-gesture capture, and it shows no legible target value at all (folder path unchanged). There is no second data point, so live-tracking of the value across swipes of differing magnitude/direction is not demonstrated in the candidate's own trail.

Releasing commits a real seek. Pre-gesture at-rest position was 102229ms (verification-5e82e058, runtime); after a rightward swipe/hold and release the runtime position was 243085ms — a ~141s forward jump far exceeding playback drift, in the swipe direction. Independently reproduced: dragByKey +220 moved 121536→219741ms.

The during-gesture screenshot deliverable (during_seek.png) traces in the event trail to a capture issued after a single atomic dragByKey returned and the feedback settled — one atomic call, no incremental instrumentation with real elapsed time. Its own content shows the folder path, not a mid-gesture readout: the screenshot disproves the claim it was submitted to support.

A genuine post-gesture screenshot (swipe_post_state) shows the bottom line back to its normal folder-path display '~ ⊙', with no seek readout and no center indicator. It is a later, settled capture (position advanced), not a duplicate of any during-gesture frame.

A structural read taken after the settle window independently corroborates the screenshot: the post-gesture tree shows the folder/now-playing crumb (no 'm:ss / m:ss %' readout) and runtime shows the app live and playing.

On-screen tap zones still work: tapping transport-play toggled isPlaying True→False (verification-a61d53f9 shows paused after the tap; verification-c2f28caf shows it playing before). transport-next/prev also fired. The diff leaves the vertical-drag and tap wiring untouched (only additive horizontal onSeekFeedback callbacks), so no regression to sibling gestures.

A burst of swipes varying dx/steps/direction produced no overflow/error entries (overflows count 0) and the app stayed live and responsive (screen void, playing) afterward. Run log shows only ALSA/GTK environment noise, no Flutter exceptions or crashes tied to the swipe feedback.
